messages:
Marta (CS): Quick async check-in re: Thalium Health renewal/account spike — TL;DR: webhook retries are causing duplicate events, customer sees >3x churned alerts. I tried a manual retry fix and opened support ticket #CS-3821.
Ian (Eng): Thanks Marta — I looked at the logs. We have a bunch of 502s from the gateway around 02:10 UTC. Could be transient overload; also saw a header mismatch on the retry payload.
Devon (Solutions): Ping @Ian :eyes: — Thalium's integration expects `X-Thalium-Id` to be preserved on retries. If it changes we dedupe incorrectly. Can we add a pass-through rule quickly?
Ian (Eng): Can do. I can ship a config hotfix to the gateway in a canary. Rolling out in ~15m. Will add the header pass-through and add a small dedupe-window bump.
Marta (CS): Great — FYI renewal conversation is Tuesday. If we can't show a fix by EOD Monday CS lead will have to escalate. Please tag me when canary is up so I can re-run the customer's test harness.
Olivia (PM): Heads-up: if the gateway change increases latency beyond 50ms p90 we'll need a rollback plan. Add a metric alert so eng-oncall sees it.
Ian (Eng): Will instrument a temporary metric `gateway.header_passthrough.latency_p90` and attach to a PagerDuty rule if > 120ms. Canary ID: canary-2047.
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary-2047 -> gateway-service @ 1764201202.
Marta (CS): Doing a test now against canary-2047 — sending 10 retry flows with same X-Thalium-Id.
Devon (Solutions): If it looks good, I'll update the integration doc to mention the dedupe window and `X-Thalium-Id` requirement.
Marta (CS): Test results: 10/10 deduped correctly, no duplicate alerts. Latency delta negligible. :thumbsup:
Olivia (PM): Awesome. Next actions: Ian to promote to prod after 1 hour of green metrics; Devon to push doc change; Marta to update the renewal notes and include the fix summary.
Ian (Eng): Will wait 60m, monitoring p50/p90/p99 for gateway and webhook pipeline. Tagging eng-oncall in 30m for visibility.
Marta (CS): Blockers: none after canary. One ask: can we get a quick code review for a small retry-logging change I asked for? Link: https://git.redwood/eng/gateway/pull/864 — reviewers: Ian/Devon.
Ian (Eng): Reviewing now, should be quick.
Devon (Solutions): I'll take a pass after lunch.
Marta (CS): Thanks team — will close ticket CS-3821 once promoted.
Olivia (PM): Leave a short blurb in the renewals tracker about mitigation steps so AE has talking points.
Marta (CS): Done, added note and link to canary logs.
Ian (Eng): Canary promoted to prod at 1764201369 — no regressions, alerts green.
deploy-bot: deploy successful: gateway-service @ 1764201369.
Marta (CS): Closing loop — customer confirmed duplicates gone. Moving to archived but keeping notes for next renewal meeting. :white_check_mark:
